lede: The biggest item this week is Tuesday's San Miguel County Commissioners meeting, where four separate public hearings will take up proposed Land Use Code amendments that would add an entirely new Natural Resources article to the county code — covering forestry, oil and gas, and geothermal operations. Also worth your attention: Telluride's HARC takes up the large-scale Shandoka redevelopment at 860 Black Bear Rd in two public hearings, the school board revisits the mill levy override discussion, and Norwood's Planning and Zoning digs into land use and master plan updates.
